business_summary: Hokuhoku Financial Group, Inc., through its subsidiaries, provides various banking products and services to individuals, and small and medium-sized enterprises. The company provides financial instruments, M&A advisory work, business succession consulting work, management consulting work, credit card operations, loan guarantees, software development, venture capital, document management, concentrated business processing, maintenance, ICT infrastructure construction, cash management and settlement, concentrated business processing, economic surveys, survey and research services, and consulting services. Hokuhoku Financial Group, Inc. was incorporated in 2003 and is headquartered in Toyama, Japan.
business_summary_ko: 호쿠호쿠 파이낸셜 그룹(Hokuhoku Financial Group, Inc.)은 자회사를 통해 개인 및 중소기업에 다양한 은행 상품 및 서비스를 제공합니다. 금융상품, M&A 자문업무, 사업승계 컨설팅 업무, 경영컨설팅 업무, 신용카드 업무, 대출보증, 소프트웨어 개발, 벤처캐피탈, 문서관리, 집중사업처리, 유지보수, ICT 인프라 구축, 현금관리 및 결제, 집중사업처리, 경제조사, 조사연구용역, 컨설팅 서비스를 제공합니다. Hokuhoku Financial Group, Inc.는 2003년에 설립되었으며 일본 도야마에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
